text: Thank you hero! When I found out I would be voiceless until someone broke the silence, I didn't think that this is what they meant. I was trapped here by an evil witch when I criticized her artwork. To be fair it was really awful. One thing about this spell: pictures can enter my world, and my magic can enter yours. Anyways, time to rescue me. Draw your sword!
description: A young adult princess with a clear, bright, melodious female voice and a light British English accent. Warm, poised and confident, with playful curiosity and a smile in her voice. Speak at a lively, natural conversational pace, with crisp diction and short pauses. An intimate speaking performance, expressive and grounded.
